Subject: SOC 2 Type II report request and audit period clarification

Diego —

Acme is kicking off a security review for a Q3 initiative and our procurement team is asking for Redwood's most recent SOC 2 Type II report (if available), along with the audit period covered. We also need to understand any bridge letter options you offer (our legal team sometimes requests one when the report date doesn't align with our internal timelines).

Can you confirm:
- Whether you have a Type II report for the period covering any part of 2026–2027 and the exact audit window (start/end dates)?
- If a bridge letter is available and what it covers (controls, timebound statements, or simply scope extension)?
- Preferred secure transfer method for the report and supporting evidence index (SFTP, SharePoint link, or DocuSign/portal)?

We're hoping to include this in our vendor packet by next Wednesday (2027-06-23). Happy to sign an NDA if needed — please let us know the fastest route.

Thanks,
Jordan
Senior Security Program Manager
Acme, Inc.
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the note and the timeline. We can support this request. Quick answers up front:
- We do have a SOC 2 Type II report covering 2026-01-01 through 2026-12-31 (Type II for our security and availability controls).
- We provide a standard bridge letter that covers changes since the report date for a restricted set of controls (we'll attach the sample). For material changes outside normal operating parameters we will call those out explicitly; otherwise the bridge letter confirms no material changes to the control environment since the report end date.
- Preferred transfer options: secure link to a short-lived SharePoint/OneDrive package (preferred), or an SFTP drop if your security team requires it. DocuSign is available for attestation documents but not for report delivery.

I attached a short "evidence intake checklist" and the bridge letter sample to this reply. Marissa is looping in our compliance lead (Neha) who can provide the evidence index and handle intake for audited artifacts. If you need an NDA first, we can sign your mutual NDA or provide ours; the latter is usually faster.

Action items I propose:
- Jordan: confirm preferred transfer method and whether you need an NDA prior to delivery.
- Marissa/Neha: prepare Evidence_Index.xlsx and a zip of non-sensitive artifacts (redacted where necessary) and a guidance note on PII/non-production excerpts.

I'll plan to send the report once Jordan confirms the transfer path; if you need the bridge letter in the meantime I can send a signed PDF.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Director, Strategic Accounts — Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Bridge_Letter_Sample.docx (template), SOC2_Request_Form.pdf (request form)

Jordan / Diego —

Following up with the practical intake steps and a short template you can use when routing this internally. Notes below and I attached the Evidence_Index.xlsx for your reference.

Intake checklist (short):
- Confirm legal requirements: Do you require a signed NDA or an access agreement for the report? If so, please send the template.
- Audit period acceptance: The SOC 2 Type II we have covers 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31. Our bridge letter template covers the period from 2027-01-01 up to the date the letter is signed and states whether any material control changes occurred.
- Evidence scope: We do not share raw production logs. The Evidence_Index.xlsx maps control families to representative artifacts (policies, SOC control narratives, configuration snapshots, change logs). Where artifacts contain PII or customer-specific records we provide redacted extracts or summaries.
- Delivery options: we can deliver via a time-limited SharePoint package (recommended), SFTP, or via a secure review room (vendor portal). Let us know which you prefer and who will be assigned from Acme to validate receipt.

Suggested reply you can paste into your security packet:
"Redwood Inference has provided their SOC 2 Type II report (audit period 2026-01-01 — 2026-12-31) and a standard bridge letter covering controls status through the date of issuance. Sensitive artifacts are redacted per best-practice guidance; representative evidence is included in an Evidence Index."

Neha — can you prepare the Evidence_Index.xlsx and flag any artifacts that require an executed NDA? I will coordinate signing if Jordan confirms his legal team's process.

Marissa Cole
Senior Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Evidence_Index.xlsx (maps artifacts to SOC control criteria; redaction guidance included)
